about.title: About Nandhini Anand Jeyahar
about.subtitle: Interdisciplinary background spanning computer vision, cognitive science, and systems facilitation.
about.bio_p1: My journey started with a fascination for genetic algorithms and machine vision. Over two decades, it has evolved into a deep practice of systems thinking, data engineering, and group dynamics.
about.bio_p2: I work with teams who want to make better decisions. Sometimes that means writing optimized C++ scene detection code, sometimes it means auditing dataset leakage, and sometimes it means facilitating applied theater circles.

portfolio.title: Evidence Portfolio & Case Studies
portfolio.subtitle: Empirical case studies mapped to problems, trade-offs, and lessons.

narrative.title: Speculative Systems Research
narrative.subtitle: Exploring collective coordination, governance, and institutional alignment through narrative and thought experiments.
narrative.disclosure_desc: The MeWe series is developed through an iterative collaboration between myself and modern language models. The ideas, worldbuilding, themes, questions and direction originate from my ongoing research interests. AI is used as a collaborative writing partner to explore alternatives, refine prose, experiment with narrative structure and accelerate iteration. Final editorial decisions, conceptual direction and thematic coherence remain human-guided.
narrative.research_philosophy: Why Speculative Fiction? Some questions are difficult to investigate through technical writing alone. Stories allow us to simulate societies, organizations, incentives, and long-term consequences — serving as speculative research instruments alongside software and consulting.
